category: Japanese doujin marketplace — GB-scale arbitrary archives

free_tier.stated: （1） 作品本体 | 10GBまで。対応形式：zip・rar・7z ※4GB以上は、RARまたは7-zip形式で。
free_tier.notes: ファイル容量が10GBを超えてもお取り扱いは可能です。

egress.terms: Purchaser-authenticated download; no public egress figure. No CDN hot-link.

interface_detail: Web circle upload; no public write API. viviON ID login.
chaining: 10 GB of arbitrary archive per work, with an explicit path above 10 GB, is the largest Japanese-language per-object figure found. Each work is a shard.
limits_note: per-object-cap 10 GB web / larger on request; formats zip/rar/7z; >4 GB must be RAR or 7z.
reliability_note: Circle registration requires a payout bank account and, for paid sales, My Number (individual number) registration. So while the ID itself is email-based, monetisation is national-id gated. Review is write-gated (審査).
confidence_note: the webup page states the 10 GB per-work cap and the accepted formats
